newsitem.title: BOSNIA: Bosnian parliament approves peacetime cabinet.
newsitem.headline: Bosnian parliament approves peacetime cabinet.

text.p: Bosnia's inter-ethnic parliament appointed a peacetime cabinet on Friday, approving nominations for three ministries which comprise a weak central government ruling over Serb and Moslem-Croat territories.

The Council of Ministers, or cabinet, is led by two co-chairmen, Haris Silajdzic, a Moslem, and former Bosnian prime minister, and Boro Bosic, a Serb. The three ministry posts were equally distributed among Moslem, Serb and Croat representatives.
